Return Policy

Return Policy

Learn More About Our Return Policy

We want our customers to have only the best experience with our products, so we take all quality control issues very seriously.

That being said, since our product is consumable, we only accept returns or exchanges in the following situations:

  • The product is in some way defective (presence of mould, fungus or another foreign contaminant).
  • There has been a supplier recall of the product.
  • You have mistakenly received the wrong product and the product is unopened in original packaging (no signs of tampering).

In order to return your product, the following criteria must be met:

  • The original receipt is provided.
  • The product is returned within 15 days of purchase.
  • To be eligible for an exchange, products returned by a consumer must contain a minimum of 50% of the cannabis contents, provided they meet the other criteria outlined in our return policy.

Return Policy FAQ

Can I exchange my product for a different one?

Yes, we hold a license from the province of British Columbia and in the city of Mission to operate and do business. We are a licenced retail Cannabis Store.

Yes, if:

  • the product is defective (presence of mould, fungus or another foreign contaminant) and the original receipt is provided and within 15 days of purchase.
    if you received the wrong product and the product is unopened in original packaging (without signs of tampering) and the original receipt is provided within 15 days of purchase.

No, if:

  • you just didn’t like the product.
Can I get my payment refunded?

All of our cannabis products are sourced directly from Licensed Producers via the Liquor Distribution Branch of British Columbia. This includes producers from here in British Columbia, as well as across Canada.

  • No, all sales are final. Exchanges are only permitted if the product is defective.

Please have your receipt ready for a quicker return process. If you have any questions or feedback on any of our products, don’t hesitate to let us know.
